summary: Forever's melee hunter: Survival with a cat, built on Expose Prey into Mongoose Bite.
rotation: Pre-pull: walk into melee at -6s, Aspect of the Beast at -3s
Racials, potions and other cooldowns on cooldown
Mongoose Bite whenever Expose Prey (or a dodge) opens it
Raptor Strike queued on the next swing when ready
Wing Clip in free GCDs (mana >= 50%), held when Mongoose Bite or Strider Kick is about ready
consumes: Dense Sharpening Stone (main hand and off hand)
caveats: Pet scaling uses 10% of RAP (SoD placeholder). SoD's 22% would add 18.
Assumed: Raptor Strike rank 8 adds 96, halfway between the client and Era.
Left out: Fire-toasted Bun (+9, seasonal) and Elemental Sharpening Stone (Molten Core plans).
Assumed: 22% more crit per Agility than Classic.
Assumed: pet hits scale with attack speed as in Classic. Every cat speed sims within 1 DPS.
Survival never shoots, so the ranged weapon doesn't matter.
Assumed: Immolation Trap adds 2% of ranged attack power a tick (+15.5 DPS). The client has no coefficient yet.
The raid's Trueshot Aura adds 1.0 through the pet.
notes: Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_sv) unchanged; it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions. Distance is 5 yd as in the mksettings raid the number was measured in (the UI preset starts at 25 yd; the APL walks in 6s before the pull, which the preset says costs nothing). Survival keeps a 1.0s cat out (DefaultOptions).
